name: BA-55
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A bassline after the Erica Synths DB-01: one VCO, sub, noise, detune, an acid filter, drive, accent and slide, a 64-step sequencer
description: A monophonic bassline in the manner of the Erica Synths Bassline DB-01: one VCO (triangle, saw, square), a sub-oscillator an octave down, noise, a BBD-style DETUNE, an aggressive 12 dB filter in the Polivoks / Acidbox spirit (low-pass or band-pass, saturating, self-oscillating), DRIVE on one knob, envelopes for VCA, filter and pitch, 303-style ACCENT and SLIDE, three modulators, distortion, chorus and delay/reverb, and a 64-step sequencer with accent, slide, tie, probability, swing and a random pattern generator. 16 presets, MIDI clock in. Unofficial.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
